name: cmdb_transaction
label: CMDB Transaction Table
description: The CMDB transaction table is used for tracking configuration management-related statuses, time dimension statistics, and association queries, which are suitable for reporting scenarios.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Work order ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: expire_time
fields.description: Snapshot timeout time, after which it will be automatically deleted if not submitted.

fields.name: commit_time
fields.description: Submission time. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the ID field, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_commit_time
indexes.description: Standard index covering the commit_time field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.
